review.notes: Inspected all 24 after-page renders and compared before/after. Pixel differences occur only on pages 1 and 10 and only inside the planned redaction rectangles. Page 1 author, affiliation, contact, arXiv side identifier, and author-linked release footnote are removed; page 10 acknowledgments/funding text is removed. Candidate text extraction, metadata, and link inspection found no remaining planned forbidden identifiers or hidden URI/metadata clues. Scientific body text, figures, tables, page numbering, and ordinary references appear preserved without clipping.

token_usage.accounting_note: Input totals include cached input; output totals include reasoning output. These subsets are not added again. Totals cover reported usage only; attempts without usage may still have consumed tokens.
